notes.title: Quickfix for Steam integration
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a steam_appid.txt file to the bundle, so that Steam integration works even when the game is launched directly from the executable
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.2.3
notes.notes:
[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Dark mode can now be enabled from the Options menu
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Better random number generation for Custom Levels
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Sound and Music sliders showing the scientific notation number when it should be 0
[*] Pressing Escape when in the Custom Game Menu now takes you back to the Main Menu instead of quitting the game
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.2.2
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed visual inconsistencies caused by the background of the cells in the game grid overlapping the cell border on some devices
[*] Undo should now not work when a level is completed
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Better performance by only drawing the active cells in the game grid
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.2.1
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fix[/b]

[list]
[*] When first launching the game, use the current monitor resolution instead of the highest resolution available
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Control Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Adds the ability to backtrack the current temporary chain
[*] Smaller sub-chains can now be deleted by right-clicking, allowing the player to fix issues without going back and undoing everything they've done
[*] Undo now deletes only the last chain that connects 2 valid numbers
[*] Adds trimming to the current temporary chain to remove non-numbered cells at the edges of the chain
[*] Adds a tutorial level explaining the improvements to the controls
[/list]
